caribbean.headline: Caribbean Conditions: Nassau
caribbean.paragraph: Nassau in the Bahamas is the highest-impact location in the Caribbean this period, with winds peaking at 21 kt and seas building to 2.0 ft with ESE swell at 5s periods. 75% rain probability -- expect disrupted conditions for shore excursions and tender operations.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Marseille
mediterranean.paragraph: Marseille in the Central Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 15 kt and seas building to 2.3 ft with WSW swell at 4s periods. less than 10% rain probability -- overall conditions are favorable for cruise operations.
